text_block_list.text:
When I headed to the gym to brainstorm 
training routines—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Nghhh, not yet...! Take thiiiis!

Twin Turbo was wobbling precariously as 
she hoisted a remarkably heavy barbell.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... I'm totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo's gonna train hard and get 
super-duper buff!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yup! I wanna get strong and blow everyone 
away!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Turbo got boxed out right at the 
start during her last race, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo wants to run in the very front the 
whole time! It's so frustrating! SO 
FRUSTRATING!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I want to take the lead next time, so I'm 
gonna train my power!
choice_data_list: In that case, you should prioritize speed.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaat!? It's not power?

I explained that she should overwhelm 
everyone with speed the moment the race 
starts and maintain the lead all the way 
through.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Overwhelm them with speed right from the 
start...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh... If I stay in the lead the whole 
time, Turbo stays in first place 
forever...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right! Turbo's gonna train her 
explosive speed like crazy on the 
treadmill!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Daaargh, yeeaaah! Full Turbo throooottle!!

Twin Turbo cranked the treadmill up to max 
speed right off the bat and launched into 
an all-out sprint.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Heheh, right?♪

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Now that Turbo's got peerless power, she's 
guaranteed to be the strongest ever!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Here I go! I'll show you just how strong I 
am!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Daaargh, yeeaaah!! Full poweeer!!!

Twin Turbo challenged the heavy barbell 
once more, but—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hauaa...! M-My arms... went totally numb!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Not done yet, though...! One more 
tiiiime!!!

Worried she would hurt her arms if she 
overdid it, I decided to wrap up the 
training session early.
